achievements.name: Power Star
achievements.detail: Collect a Power Star from a course in Super Mario 64.

achievements.name: Coin Star
achievements.detail: Gather 100 coins inside one Super Mario 64 course so its extra Power Star appears.

achievements.name: Bowser's Key
achievements.detail: Defeat Bowser in Super Mario 64 and use the key from that fight on a locked door in Peach's castle.

achievements.name: Cap Switch
achievements.detail: Press a red, green, or blue switch in Super Mario 64 to unlock that cap for later courses.

achievements.name: Shine Sprite
achievements.detail: Complete an episode in Super Mario Sunshine and take the Shine Sprite it awards.

achievements.name: FLUDD Nozzle
achievements.detail: Beat a boss in Super Mario Sunshine that awards a new FLUDD nozzle and equip it.

achievements.name: Yoshi
achievements.detail: Spray a Yoshi egg with the juice of the fruit in its thought bubble so Yoshi hatches.

achievements.name: Blue Coin Trade
achievements.detail: Exchange ten blue coins at Delfino Plaza in Super Mario Sunshine for a Shine Sprite.

achievements.name: Launch Star
achievements.detail: Spin into a Launch Star in Super Mario Galaxy and travel along the path it opens.

achievements.name: Hungry Luma
achievements.detail: Feed Star Bits to a Hungry Luma in Super Mario Galaxy until it transforms into a new destination.

achievements.name: Grand Star
achievements.detail: Beat a boss galaxy in Super Mario Galaxy and collect the Grand Star at its end.

achievements.name: Prankster Comet
achievements.detail: Clear a Prankster Comet challenge in Super Mario Galaxy and collect the Power Star it offers.

achievements.name: Full Star Set
achievements.detail: Collect all 120 Power Stars in Super Mario 64, all 120 Shine Sprites in Super Mario Sunshine, and all 120 Power Stars in Super Mario Galaxy.
